title: Footnote to the Amendment Schedule: an Approved Name Change and the Charge per Traveller, Vacation Package Products
content:
*Footnote to the amendment charges published for the Vacation Package Products.* Where a name-change request that the operations desk has recorded against the package stands approved, the administration charge per traveller is read from the name-change column rather than from the amendment administration column, and how far the change falls before departure decides how much of it is taken. The distance is counted in whole days from the day being handled to the departure date shown on the package record.

**At or inside the deadline.** Where an approved name-change request stands against the package and the change falls at or inside the product's name-change deadline before departure — that is, where the whole days to departure are equal to or fewer than the deadline published against the product booked — the administration charge per traveller is the product's name-change charge per traveller.

**More than the deadline before departure.** Where an approved name-change request stands against the package and the change falls more than the product's name-change deadline before departure — the whole days to departure exceeding that deadline — the administration charge per traveller is the product's name-change charge per traveller taken at the early-change share published for this calculation, which is 80 per cent.

**Where no approved name-change request stands.** Where the count of approved name-change requests recorded against the package is 0, no charge of this kind is substituted.

| Approved name-change requests against the package | Whole days to departure against the product's name-change deadline | Administration charge per traveller |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 or more | equal to the deadline | the product's name-change charge per traveller |
| 1 or more | fewer than the deadline | the product's name-change charge per traveller |
| 1 or more | more than the deadline | that charge taken at 80 per cent |
| 0 | either | none of this kind |

*On the boundary, hypothetically.* On the Escorted Tour Package the name-change deadline is 21 calendar days and the name-change charge is 125.00 USD per traveller. With an approved request standing and exactly 21 whole days to departure, the change falls at the deadline and the charge per traveller is 125.00 USD. With 22 whole days to departure it falls more than the deadline before departure, and the charge per traveller is 100.00 USD.
